guarantee.notice_alt: Legal guarantee – harmonised notice on the legal guarantee of conformity (minimum two years)
guarantee.label_alt: GARAN – producer guarantee of durability: {{ years }} years, in addition to the legal guarantee
guarantee.editor_placeholder: GARAN label: shown only for products whose metafield “guarantee_years” is greater than 2.

repair.default_text: Right to repair: if goods are defective within the legal guarantee period, you may choose between repair and replacement. If you choose repair, the legal guarantee period is extended once by twelve months (Directive (EU) 2024/1799; applies to contracts concluded from 31 July 2026).
